# SaneVideo

> SaneVideo is a free Mac app for making screen and camera videos for YouTube. Record your screen with your camera in a bubble, press Clean Up once to cut silences and filler words, add captions, and export for YouTube or as vertical Shorts and Reels. Everything runs on your Mac: no account and no uploads. Made by SaneApps.

## Facts
- Price: free, with every feature. No subscription, no account, no in-app purchase. Paying what you want is optional (https://go.saneapps.com/buy/sanevideo).
- Where to get it: direct download at https://sanevideo.com/download, or the Mac App Store (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sanevideo/id6770294375). Both are free and the same app.
- Requirements: a Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 26 or later.
- Privacy: recording, Clean Up, captions and export run on your Mac. Recordings are never uploaded. The app checks for updates, sends anonymous app counts, and downloads its speech model once the first time you use Clean Up or captions (see the privacy policy).
- Files: Movies/SaneVideo (Recordings, Projects, Exports, and Shorts for vertical clips).
- Code: public on GitHub under the PolyForm Shield license (https://github.com/sane-apps/SaneVideo).

## Features
- Record your screen with a movable camera bubble, or the camera on its own; switch between them mid-take. Option-Command-R starts and stops from any app while the recorder is open.
- Clean Up: one click cuts silences and filler sounds such as "um" and "uh"; real words stay. Every cut can be undone.
- Captions made on your Mac; fix any line before export. YouTube exports come with a matching .srt file.
- Export at your recording's size for YouTube, plus vertical 9:16 Shorts, a GIF, a thumbnail and a transcript PDF.
- Timeline editing: trim, split (Command-B), delete; crop and zoom; blur or replace the background; color effects.
